==English==

===Etymology===
{{root|en|ine-pro|*h₂er-}}
From {{uder|en|fr|inerte}}, from {{uder|en|la|iners||inactive, inert}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈɜːt/|/ɪˈnɜːt/|a=UK}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪnˈɝt/|/ənˈɝt/|/ɪˈnɝt/|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-inert.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɜː(ɹ)t|s=2}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# [[unable|Unable]] to [[move]] or [[act]]; [[inanimate]].
#: {{syn|en|dormant|immovable|Thesaurus:inactive|Thesaurus:immobile}}
# [[sluggish|Sluggish]] or [[lethargic]].
#: {{syn|en|ponderous|slothful|Thesaurus:lazy|Thesaurus:slow}}
# {{lb|en|chemistry}} Not [[readily]] [[react]]ing with other [[element]]s or [[compound]]s.
#: {{syn|en|unreactive}}
# Having no [[therapeutic]] [[action]].
